programs.title: Michael Portillo's Pyrenees Adventure
programs.desc: Michael is in the Catalonian Pyrenees, and this journey is a deeply personal one. His father fled through these mountains as a political refugee from the Spanish Civil War.

programs.title: James May's Great Explorers
programs.desc: James rewrites stories of the greatest explorers in his inimitable entertaining way, starting with Columbus - and how he merely 'stumbled across' two continents, then took the spoils.
